pages: A Norwegian farmhouse kitchen with nobody in it. Foreground: a bare hearthstone and a shelf on the sill holding a rack of eleven unburnt candles standing upright, none of them lit. Middle distance: the long pine table and the black iron stove. Background: a frost-white window. Firelight lies on the stone, cold grey daylight on the glass.

Foreground: a tall thin man's hand lying open on the pine table, nails cut short and clean. Middle distance: Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, looks at that hand only. Background: the stove and the sill shelf with eleven unburnt candles. Red stove-light lies along the wood.

Foreground: a tall thin man's boots, resoled at the heels only, by the hearth. Middle distance: he sits with his back to the wall, a dark coat mended twice, at the shoulder and in the back. Background: Signe, white-haired in a dark shawl, on the bench, and eleven unburnt candles on the sill. Firelight is the only light.

Foreground: Sora's mother's hand flat on the pine table, and above it Signe's mouth opening and shutting again. Middle distance: Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, sits opposite the guest and looks at his open hand. Background: eleven unburnt candles in the rack, the frost-white window. Low firelight.

Winter evening a year earlier. Foreground: Signe's hands flat on the pine table, white hair loose, a dark shawl round her shoulders. Middle distance: the girl Sora, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, leaning in to listen. Background: the hearth and eleven unburnt candles on the sill. Low firelight.

Foreground: Sora's hand lifting one candle out of the rack on the sill. Middle distance: three candles lying face down on the hearthstone, wicks up, and the guest in his chair with his clean hands on the table. Background: eight unburnt candles still standing in the rack, the frost-white window. Firelight and stove-red on the stone.

Foreground: a fourth candle laid face down on the hearthstone beside three others, wicks up. Middle distance: Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, still talking across the pine table; the guest unmoved; her mother's chair pushed back. Background: seven unburnt candles in the rack. Firelight jumps once.

Foreground: six candles face down on the hearthstone, wicks up, and one more still in Sora's hand. Middle distance: Sora at the pine table in her white linen shift and dark green shawl, pale brown hair in a plain bun; the guest in his chair; Signe on the bench. Background: five unburnt candles left in the rack, the window. Firelight.

Foreground: nine candles lying face down on the hearthstone, wicks up. Middle distance: Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, at the pine table; the guest with one hand off the wood. Background: two unburnt candles left in the rack on the sill, the frost-white window. Low firelight.

Foreground: one candle alone in the rack on the sill. Middle distance: ten candles face down on the hearthstone, and Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, in her white linen shift and dark green shawl, at the pine table; Signe turning her head. Background: her mother with both hands in her lap, the frost-white window. Quiet firelight.

Foreground: the guest's hand open on the pine table, palm up, empty, clean, beside his plate turned so the food faces away. Middle distance: Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, in her white linen shift and dark green shawl, leaning close. Background: one candle in the rack, ten face down on the hearthstone. Steady firelight; nothing moves.

Foreground: the guest standing from the hearth chair, his clean hands behind his back. Middle distance: Sora's mother at the pine table with her own plate, Sora seated in her white linen shift and dark green shawl. Background: the open door, and eleven unburnt candles standing in the rack on the sill. Firelight, and cold light off the snow.

Foreground: Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, seated at the pine table. Middle distance: her mother talking, the aunt kneeling at the black iron stove, the uncle in a dark work coat. Background: the open door and eleven unburnt candles in the rack on the sill. Bright firelight.

Foreground: Sora's two hands flat on the pine table, empty. Middle distance: her mother glancing at the door, Signe in a dark shawl turned away toward the fire, the aunt's shawl over the bench end. Background: the eleven unburnt candles in the rack on the sill, the frost-white window. Firelight, and every face in the room turned to a wall.

Morning. Foreground: a row of eleven cut candle stubs on the shelf above the hearth, none of them blackened. Middle distance: the girl Sora, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, standing at that shelf. Background: the black iron stove and older rows of stubs. Grey daylight on the frost-white window.

The girl Sora, nineteen, pale brown hair in a plain bun, a white linen shift under a dark green shawl, stands alone halfway up a frozen lane between bare hedges, the farmhouse behind her. Foreground: her boots in the ice and one hand open at her side. Background: grey sky, white at the horizon, no smoke. Flat cold morning light.

A snowy village lane with nobody in it. Foreground: an old brick wall with an opening about the width of a hand, the bricks on each side worn round at the edges. Middle distance: frost along the top course, a drift banked under the opening. Background: bare ash trees, grey houses with smoke, flat white sky. Even white winter light.

Evening of threshing in a low barn. Foreground: Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, on a bench, lips moving through a long sentence. Middle distance: Ilma Vey across the threshing floor, hands on her knees, saying it over again. Background: a frost-white window, straw heaped to the roof. Lamplight from one low lamp.

The same wall, seen close and from below. Foreground: the opening about the width of a hand, its bricks worn round and grey at the edges, nothing inside it but dark. Middle distance: frost along the top course, and the shadow the opening makes. Background: bare ash branches, flat white sky. Flat white winter light, no shadow anywhere.

Foreground: Hesper's boots on the low stones, blue with frost at the toes. Middle distance: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, on her toes, face a hand's width from the bricks, both hands deep in her sleeves, speaking. Background: the hand-wide opening, bare ash trees, flat white sky. Flat white light.

A winter day between Novembers. Foreground: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, in the yard by the byre door, lips moving, a finger counting on her thumb. Middle distance: snow under her boots, the byre wall, an open gate. Background: bare ash trees, grey houses, flat white sky. Flat white daylight, no shadow.

Foreground: Hesper's boots on the low stones, blue with frost at the toes. Middle distance: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, on her toes, face a hand's width from the bricks, hands out of her sleeves, palms up. Background: the hand-wide opening, bare ash trees, flat white sky. Flat white light.

The lane at Candlemas, deep in snow. Foreground: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, standing in churned snow. Middle distance: hay heaped in the lane to her waist, three straw hives under the ash by the brick wall, bees thick in air. Background: grey houses with smoke, flat white sky. Flat white light.

Foreground: bean stalks heaped by the gate, a sickle in the snow. Middle distance: Timo, a man who works in the fields, bent over the last of the beans; the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, past him, chin up. Background: the brick wall with its hand-wide opening, bare ash trees. Flat white light.

Foreground: Hesper's boots on the low stones, blue with frost at the toes. Middle distance: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, straighter on her toes, chin above the opening, right hand shut into a fist, left hand open. Background: the hand-wide opening, bare ash trees, flat white sky. Flat white light.

Spring, an empty barn. Foreground: Hesper kneeling at an open seed bin with both hands in it, and nothing in her hands. Middle distance: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, swept boards, more bins along the wall. Background: bare ash trees through the open door, flat white sky. Flat April light.

Nobody in the lane. Foreground: a barn floor swept bare, straw caught in the joints, a broom against the wall. Middle distance: open grain bins along the wall, every one of them empty, and new bridge timber through the far door. Background: grey houses with smoke, bare ash trees, flat white sky. Flat light, early spring, no shadows.

The yard in April, the frost gone. Foreground: a new ash handle on a rake across Hesper's hands. Middle distance: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, holding it; her father turned away at the seed bin. Background: the byre, grey houses, a low grey sky. One thin sun in flat light.

The top of the lane. Foreground: small boots on the low stones, and frost on the two ears above them. Middle distance: Bett, eight years old, in a brown coat, standing close against the wall, mouth open, hands still at her sides. Background: the hand-wide opening in the brick, bare ash trees, flat white sky. Flat white light.

The last day of the year, at a kitchen table. Foreground: a board two feet long laid on the table, its face cut all over in close deep scratches and rubbed black with soot. Middle distance: Ilma Vey's hands pushing it across, Hesper's two hands taking it. Background: a frost-white window, a grey room, one tea cup. Low winter lamplight.

The girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, alone at the kitchen wall, saying a long sentence aloud, three fingers held up. Foreground: the two-foot board flat on the table, its close scratches black with soot. Middle distance: her sleeves pushed back, her chair in. Background: a frost-white window, a bare shelf. Morning light.

The wall in the lane again. Foreground: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, a pace back from the bricks, arms at her sides, head tilted to listen. Middle distance: the hand-wide opening in the old brick, unchanged. Background: bare ash trees, grey houses, flat white sky. Flat white light, the same as always.

No one in the lane. Foreground: the new cooper's barn, its fresh pale beams and its new doors, snow banked against the wall. Middle distance: the old brick wall with the hand-wide opening in it, and a swept yard between. Background: bare ash trees, grey houses with smoke, flat white sky. Flat white light on new timber.

April, on the step above the lane. Foreground: the two-foot board across Hesper's knees, its close scratches black with soot under her thumb. Middle distance: the girl Hesper, nine, dark hair in two braids, a bright red coat, sitting, elbows on her knees. Background: the brick wall and its hand-wide opening, bare ash trees, white sky. Soft April light.
